zh.summary: 升级 Portable 时保留你选的内核，不再悄悄换回安装包自带的版本。
highlights: 之前升级会把你选的测试版内核换回安装包自带的内核，用测试版创建的会话会显示异常（对话空白、输入框跑到顶部）。现在升级完成后，如果你原来的内核已经在新版本上验证通过，会自动换回去。
如果新版本还没验证好你原来的内核，升级结果里会提示“等待验证”，验证完成后在 设置 → 更新 → 内核版本 里重新选择即可。
upgradeNotes: 从 0.8.11 升级会保留设置、会话、插件和默认工作区。
想先避免显示异常，可以等内核验证完成后再升级。

en.summary: Upgrading Portable now keeps the core you selected instead of silently switching back to the bundled one.
highlights: Upgrades used to replace a test core you had selected with the one bundled in the package, and sessions created on the test core then rendered wrongly (blank conversation, composer at the top). After an upgrade, if your previous core is already verified for the new version, it is restored automatically.
If the new version has not verified your previous core yet, the upgrade result says it is awaiting verification; choose it again under Settings → Update → Core version once it is ready.
upgradeNotes: Upgrading from 0.8.11 keeps settings, sessions, plugins, and the default workspace.
To avoid the display problem entirely, wait until your core is verified before upgrading.
